Subject: Your wrongful termination matter

Dear Mr. Pai,

Thank you for meeting us on 22 December 2020 about your dispute with Emerald Technologies Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the dismissal followed a one-sided domestic enquiry. The matter is listed before the Panaji Labour Court.

Our advice is to demand the domestic enquiry report and challenge it for breach of natural justice. Please collect the charge sheet, the enquiry report and the reply to the charge sheet and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
